wanted: An even scrim (or a centred one) for text in the middle of a photo: the kit's scrim is strongest at the foot only, so the centre variant uses the token colour bg-bg/65 instead.

The browser check's stylesheet misses classes the kit picks in a ternary (type-display, type-h2, type-h3, type-lead, type-small in Text, max-w-prose/content/wide in Container), because classesIn reads only className="…" and cx('…'). Headlines are therefore checked at body size unless some block writes the class literally. I re-checked this block by hand with those classes added (screenshots at 360 and 1280, no overflow seen), but the gate itself did not.
notes: Photo, shade and text share one grid cell, so the photo grows with the text and nothing clips; height comes from aspect tokens (portrait on phones, landscape at @md, wide at @lg). Both checks passed on the first run; caps are headline 48 / subhead 120 (bottom) and 40 / 100 (center).
